**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve inherited reasoning intent in active config**

When `LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET*` supplies the defaults, these store the effective values reported by `/status` rather than `loadedReasoningBudgetRequested` and its message counterpart. Consequently, changing an unrelated setting or saving the active model sends and persists those inherited values as explicit flags; subsequent recipe reuse sees the request change from `-1`/empty and performs an unnecessary full reload, and the model no longer follows the environment default. Unlike the fixed rollback path, this active-config snapshot still discards the newly tracked requested pair, so use that pair until the user actually edits these controls.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve the managed macOS wrapper for the value probe**

On macOS installations where the managed `llama-server` entrypoint is a shell wrapper, the earlier `--help` probe resolves it through `_exec_path_for_launch()` specifically because SIP strips the wrapper's `DYLD_*` environment, but this positive-budget probe executes the unresolved `binary`. The preflight therefore records a nonzero wrapper startup as rejection of a supported positive budget and blocks the load; execute the same resolved path used by the capability probe and actual launch.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compare resident reasoning requests instead of effective values**

When `LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET` or `LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET_MESSAGE` supplies a default, a resident model reports that effective value here while the remembered config correctly retains `-1`/empty as its request. Re-selecting that resident model after switching to an external provider therefore fails the adoption check, follows the idle-model unload path, and reloads the weights even though the backend's request-to-request comparator would reuse the server. Compare against the newly exposed `requested_reasoning_budget` and `requested_reasoning_budget_message` fields instead.
